why: Byte-identical copy of the BGOS shim at sourceCommit (BGOS PR #6039, fix/browser-busy-retry) and of bgos-claude-plugin 0.90.32 (pluginRef): the fill-only shim (28b9fc68) plus the busy browser handling. A managed browser that is still busy with an earlier command is retried with a bounded backoff under the same request id, on a call and while connecting (HOAI_BUSY_RETRY_MS, default 15 s, 0 turns it off), then answered as browser_runtime_busy, which says nothing ran and the call can be tried again; one shim sends one command at a time to one profile. Managed profile routing stays opt-in through the paired launcher.
